group_results.reason: cJSON_Delete now sets valuestring and string to NULL before freeing the item. Nothing reads these fields afterwards, so the harness's delete call is still valid and still reaches the changed code.

On the parse_string failure path, the local output pointer is now set to NULL after it is freed. Malformed string input reaches this path through the harness's parse call, which still returns NULL, and the harness handles that.

On print()'s success path, buffer->buffer is now set to NULL after the buffer is moved or freed. The function still returns the same printed pointer. The harness reaches it through cJSON_Print and cJSON_PrintUnformatted.
On print()'s failure path, pointers are now set to NULL after being freed, and the function still returns NULL. The harness only calls free() when the result is not NULL.
When print_value fails, cJSON_PrintBuffered now sets p.buffer to NULL after freeing it, and still returns NULL. The harness reaches this through its buffered branch.
cJSON_free only clears its own by-value parameter, which the caller cannot observe. The complete harness never calls cJSON_free.

build.reason: ossfuzz.sh configures the repository with CMake as a static library with tests off, builds libcjson.a, and compiles the harness against it. The harness includes ../cJSON.h. The changes add only NULL assignments to variables that are already read, so they add no new declarations or symbols.

input.reason: The harness requires the input to end with a NUL byte and to start with four 0/1 flag bytes. strlen in ParseWithOpts is therefore bounded, and every option is controlled by the input.

lifecycle.reason: The default global_hooks are malloc, free and realloc on non-MSVC platforms, and the harness never calls InitHooks. Freeing print output with free() is therefore valid. The tree is deleted once, and the minify copy is freed.

control_flow.reason: The flag bytes select between buffered, formatted and unformatted printing and whether to minify, so every branch is reachable. A parse failure returns before printing, and delete runs on every successful parse.
